$comment: Default settings of new operations, for every user of the site. Edit this file on the server, no new build needed; reload the page to see the change. A setting missing or invalid keeps the value built into 8-CAM (the browser console says which). Depths, layers and tools are always chosen from the board. See docs/architecture.md section 23.

isolation.$comment: passes: 1 to 20; overlap: 0 to 0.9 (share of the cutting width); direction: climb or conventional; combinePasses: true or false; extraOffset: mm, 0 to 5

drilling.$comment: cycle: simple or peck; peckDepth: mm per peck; dwell: s at the bottom of each hole

cutout.$comment: mode: shape or rectangle; direction: climb or conventional; tabCount: number of tabs; tabWidth, tabHeight: mm

machine.$comment: Machine of a first visit (users keep the machines they already have). Same fields as a machine file exported from the Machine tab; remove this block for the built-in CNC 3018.
machine.name: SnapMaker
